attributes.board_name: North Dakota Board of Counselor Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Professional meetings, conferences, workshops, graduate courses in counseling or other mental health fields (1 hour = 50 minutes)
rules.audit_note: Proof of completion of continued professional education is filed with the renewal application.
rules.notes: License expires two years after originally granted or last renewed; file at least 30 days before expiration or pay $100 late fee. Certified supervisors: 30 h of supervision CE per 5-year certification.

rules.accepted_credit_types: 30 LPC hours plus at least 10 hours primarily on clinical counseling, related to the licensee's intent to practice and preapproved by the Board (1 hour = 50 minutes)
rules.audit_note: Proof of completion filed with the renewal application.

topics.who: Within the 30 LPC hours: counselor ethics

rules.notes: LPCC license expires with the underlying LPC license; LPCC renewal fee $75 is in addition to the LPC renewal. Certified supervisors: 30 h of supervision CE per 5-year certification.
